title: Wheelchair Battery Health Location Comparison
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wheelchair:battery
| stats avg(battery_pct) as avg_metric count as readings by location
| sort - avg_metric
description: Compares average battery percentage across locations or contexts for wheelchair battery health equipment.
value: Location comparison can surface one room, route, or usage pattern that is harder on the equipment than the rest.
implementation: Use stable location labels such as upstairs, vehicle, office, or travel kit during ingest.
visualization: Bar chart of average metric by location.
grandmaExplanation: It logs where wheelchair battery health performs best and where it seems more stressed.
